title: Make the core Rust cucumber suite pass and add it to make check
description:
The core Rust cucumber runner (rust/tests/cucumber.rs) was never part of the gate. check-rust only ran cargo test --lib, so the file didn't even compile on the amplify-engine branch until virt-c9fc1a fixed it. The runner now skips @python-only, @bench and the crate-owned features/amplify and features/appsync folders, fails on skipped steps and exits non-zero on failure. 207 of 222 scenarios pass. These 15 still fail, with identical code and features on develop:
- Keyword mismatches, where a feature says 'And' after 'Given' but the step is #[then]/#[when]. Several have EMPTY bodies (fixture placeholders), so they need real setup, not just #[step]:
  - self_referential 'category {...} with no parent_id' (the regex misses the suffix);
  - database_validate 'every post's user_id references an existing user' and 'post ... which does not exist in users';
  - execute_nested 'job ... has 2 workers through job_assignments', 'user ... has posts', 'user ... has no posts', 'user ... has posts, and each post has comments';
  - execute_pagination 'I execute {...} and receive a next_token' and 'I page through with limit 10'.
- The 'the result should contain exactly 10 records' step is ambiguous (the generic regex at ~1343 vs the literal at ~5730).
- database_schema_dict (2): unique_temp() never creates the directory, so fs::write fails with NotFound.
- cli/query_mode: 'the output should contain the matching user record' fails its assertion.
- smoke: the Python steps shell out to a conda env 'virtuus' and need package metadata (environment-dependent). Decide whether they are @python-only or should use the repo .venv.
Done when: cargo test -p virtuus --test cucumber exits 0 and check-rust runs it.
